description: Fork of exp428. NEW HEAD STRUCTURE: residual_lut output dim = 32 (per-layer 'private' vocab channels). Each layer has its own LayerNorm(32) + Linear(32, V) head. Final logits = sum_i head_i(LN_i(r_i)). No shared residual stream and no shared unembedder/ln_final. residual_tph: 128 -> 256 (per user). Equivalent to D=192 residual stream with concatenation + block-diagonal unembedder. Inter-layer info still flows via E-stream (x_lut).
